summary_1line: Rama harshly questions Sita’s purity after rescuing her, prompting her sorrowful defense and decision to prove her chastity through a trial by fire.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita, weeping before a silent crowd, asks Lakshmana to build a funeral pyre as Rama stands apart with his head bowed.
Lakshmana reluctantly prepares a blazing pyre while warriors and monkeys watch in stunned silence.
Sita, hands folded in prayer, walks toward the roaring flames after circling Rama.
